tool_input.content:
import re
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
t = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()


def slug(h):
    h = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)", r"\1", h).strip().lower()
    h = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]", "", h)
    return h.replace(" ", "-")


heads = {slug(m) for m in re.findall(r"^#{1,6} (.+)$", t, re.M)}
heads |= set(re.findall(r'<a id="([^"]+)"', t))
links = set(re.findall(r"\]\(#([^)]+)\)", t))
print("missing:", sorted(links - heads))
print("fence lines:", len(re.findall(r"^\s*```", t, re.M)))
